```python
import re

def chunk_text(text: str, max_chars: int) -> list[str]:
    """
    Splits text into chunks of at most max_chars, preferring to break on
    sentence boundaries ('.', '!', '?'), never cutting a word.
    """
    chunks = []
    start_index = 0

    for match in re.finditer(r"[\.\?\!]", text):
        sentence_length = match.end() - match.start()
        if start_index + sentence_length <= max_chars:
            chunks.append(text[start_index:match.end()])
            start_index = match.end()
        else:
            chunks.append(text[start_index:max_chars])
            start_index = max_chars
    chunks.append(text[start_index:])

    return chunks
```

As a result, the system was unable to perform necessary maintenance tasks and had to be manually restarted at 14:31. The downtime caused by this incident was approximately 8 minutes. To prevent similar occurrences in the future, it is recommended to re-enable the monitoring alert and add a disk-space check to the post-maintenance checklist.
